meta.name: pr-to-video
meta.description: Turn a GitHub pull request (a PR URL, owner/repo#N, or 'this PR' in a checked-out repo) into a code-change explainer video — changelog, feature reveal, fix, or refactor walkthrough built from the diff, commits, and files: the input is a code change, not a website. Not a product promo (/product-launch-video) or a no-PR topic explainer (/faceless-explainer). Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将 GitHub PR 自动生成代码变更讲解视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你经常需要向团队解释代码变更。
copy.tagline_en: Turn a GitHub PR into a code-change explanation video.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to explain code changes to your team.

howto.what: 将 GitHub Pull Request（PR）转换为代码变更讲解视频。它会解析 PR 的 diff、提交和文件，自动生成脚本、画面和音频，最终合成一个视频。
howto.when: 当你提供 PR 的 URL（如 https://github.com/owner/repo/pull/123）、owner/repo#N 格式，或在已检出仓库中说“这个 PR”时触发。

say.text: 把这个 PR 做成一个讲解视频。
say.note: Claude 会开始处理该 PR 并生成视频生成流程。

say.text: 为 owner/repo#42 制作变更说明视频。

howto.what_en: Turns a GitHub pull request into a code-change explainer video. It parses the PR's diff, commits, and files, then auto-generates scripts, frames, and audio to produce a final video.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you provide a PR URL (e.g., https://github.com/owner/repo/pull/123), owner/repo#N, or say 'this PR' in a checked-out repo.

say_en.text: Turn this PR into an explainer video.
say_en.note: Claude starts processing the PR and runs the video generation workflow.

say_en.text: Make a changelog video for owner/repo#42.
say_en.note: Claude fetches the PR info from GitHub and builds the video step by step.
